serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Ground Control Software Inc. is a San Jose-based technology
company that provides a cloud-based SaaS platform called
GroundControl, designed specifically for the manufacturing sector.
The platform focuses on quality control documentation workflows,
offering secure storage, transmission, and interactive processing
capabilities while integrating large language models and neural
network technologies to accelerate AI adoption in an industry that has
been slow to embrace such tools. The company maintains strict
security and compliance standards, including ITAR (International
Traffic in Arms Regulations) registration with the U.S. Department of
Defense and self-attestation to NIST 800-171. Its infrastructure is
hosted on FedRAMP-authorized services, including AWS
Government, at a High security impact level.
